newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Netanyahu heads home after Russian visit.
newsitem.headline: Netanyahu heads home after Russian visit.

text.p: ST. PETERSBURG, Russia, March 12 (Russia) - Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu flew home from St. Petersburg on Wednesday evening after a 48-hour visit to Russia, a spokesman for the city's governor said.

Netanyahu, who met President Boris Yeltsin in Moscow on Tuesday, had spent Wednesday afternoon meeting St. Petersburg officials and visiting the Hermitage art gallery and other sites in the former tsarist capital.
